subject.title: fix(tts): allow trusted local media in message_tool_only mode

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core `message_tool_only` suppression exception for `trustedLocalMedia`, rather than requiring all such media to be delivered only through an explicit message-tool action?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but the durable trust boundary for allowing locally generated media through a deliberately suppressing mode is a product and security-policy choice rather than a purely testable implementation detail.

options.title: Accept the narrow trusted-media exception
options.body: Approve this policy if `trustedLocalMedia` is an authoritative provenance marker whose only eligible producers are intended to auto-deliver media.

options.title: Require an explicit delivery capability
options.body: Keep suppression strict and redesign TTS auto-delivery around a typed message-tool or owner-owned delivery capability if the provenance marker is too broad.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow trusted-media exception
recommendation.body: Approve this policy if `trustedLocalMedia` is an authoritative provenance marker whose only eligible producers are intended to auto-deliver media.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline explicitly routes the proposal to this account, and the remaining choice concerns the intended core delivery/security policy.
